examples.description: Delete the second scene and pull everything after it earlier on every lane

description: Delete a scene or timeline clip AND close the time it held. scope "all_tracks" (the default) removes that span of time from every lane, so everything after it moves earlier together and stays in sync; clips and captions over the span go with it, and one that crosses its edge is split or shortened. scope "own_track" closes the gap on the element's own lane only (for a scene, the other tracks then drift by its length). delete_element and delete_elements leave a clip's gap open instead. Refuses, naming the fix: an unknown id, a sticker or caption (no lane time to close), a locked track the edit moves, or with all_tracks a clip that runs past the main track's end.

element_id.description: A scene (vs_) or timeline clip (vcl_) id from get_composition.

scope.description: "all_tracks" (default) closes the time on every lane; "own_track" closes it on the element's own lane only.
